Description: Experimental single-host wallet provider. Zero applications; execution disabled. DNS, custody acceptance and cloud validation are separate.

KeyName.Description: Existing EC2 key pair; required only for SSH access.

AdminCIDR.Description: Trusted operator IPv4 CIDR for SSH. Do not use a public catch-all range.

ReleaseArchiveSHA256.Description: Verified SHA-256 of provider-release.tgz from the selected release.

AccessMethod.Description: Use Systems Manager without inbound SSH, or supply an SSH key and restricted administrator CIDR.

ElasticIPAllocationId.Description: Optional existing Elastic IP allocation in the selected Region. Its owner retains lifecycle responsibility. Otherwise the stack creates and retains an address.

InstallOnBoot.Description: Install a verified release during boot, or prepare the host for a separate reviewed installation.

HTTPSAllowedCIDR.Description: Approved IPv4 network for HTTPS. The default denies remote HTTPS; use the testing operator network during acceptance.

EnableVPN.Description: Allow the authenticated WireGuard listener. Configure host keys and peers separately before use.

Properties.GroupDescription: Wallet provider HTTPS and restricted operator SSH

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Public HTTPS gateway; operator shell access uses SSM unless SSH is selected.
must: Never expose internal API, database, bundler or cache ports.
SSH ingress requires the operator CIDR and SSH access selection.

Fn::If.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 update
apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 curl ca-certificates
systemctl enable --now docker
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash wallet-provider
usermod -aG docker wallet-provider
install -d -m 700 -o wallet-provider -g wallet-provider /home/wallet-provider/.wallet-provider
install -d -m 700 -o wallet-provider -g wallet-provider /home/wallet-provider/release
curl --fail --retry 5 --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 'https://github.com/Moovha/wallet-provider-kit/releases/download/provider-v${ReleaseVersion}/provider-release.tgz' -o /home/wallet-provider/release.tgz
printf '%s  %s\n' '${ReleaseArchiveSHA256}' /home/wallet-provider/release.tgz | sha256sum --check
tar --extract --gzip --file /home/wallet-provider/release.tgz --directory /home/wallet-provider/release
chown -R wallet-provider:wallet-provider /home/wallet-provider/release
sudo -u wallet-provider env WPK_LOCAL=false WPK_ORIGIN='https://${DomainName}' WPK_PRIVACY_URL='${PrivacyURL}' WPK_ACCEPT_PLAN=true bash /home/wallet-provider/release/install.sh

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: One active POSIX host for SQLite and the private owner-signer vault.
must: Retain encrypted storage; never start competing copies of provider data.
IMDSv2 and hop limit one isolate host credentials from bridge containers.
Wallet execution remains disabled after installation.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: EC2 host management through SSM; wallet containers cannot reach the instance profile through IMDS.
must: Grant host management only; no wallet or application authority.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Stable DNS destination independent of host stop/start and replacement.
must: Retain allocation on stack removal; retained addresses continue to incur charges.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Binds the stable destination to the active single host.
must: Use an allocation in the same Region; only one active provider host.

PublicIP.Description: Stable public IPv4 address. Create the selected hostname A record after association; verify HTTPS separately.

ClaimLocation.Description: Read privately on the host through Systems Manager or restricted SSH. Never print the claim in command output or logs.

Persistence.Value: Encrypted root EBS is retained when the instance is deleted. Retained volumes continue to incur charges. Backups and tested restore are still required.

ElasticIPAllocationId.Description: Retained stable allocation. Existing allocations remain managed by their owner; release only after DNS and recovery review.

ProviderInstanceId.Description: Managed host for Systems Manager access, or restricted SSH when selected.

ref.has: Single-host installation, DNS, administrator recovery and retained storage

Assertions.AssertDescription: SSH access requires an existing key pair.
SSH access requires a restricted administrator CIDR.
